channel.description: A 23-chapter handbook for Claude Code — permissions, context, skills, hooks, MCP and agents, worked out end to end for engineers who have to ship with it.

item.title: Permissions & Sandboxing
item.author: abhaypratap3537@gmail.com (Abhay)
item.description: Rules decide whether a tool call happens; the sandbox decides what it can touch once it does. Rule syntax and the wildcard placement that widens a rule further than intended, path anchoring, working directories, and where the OS boundary goes.
